subsystems.name: Claim extraction
subsystems.role: breaks a document or answer into atomic factual statements that can be checked separately.

subsystems.name: Evidence retrieval
subsystems.role: finds relevant passages from a trusted corpus or the live web.

subsystems.name: Source validation
subsystems.role: judges whether a cited source is credible, current and actually supports the claim.

subsystems.name: Veracity assessment
subsystems.role: compares each claim with retrieved evidence and labels it supported, contradicted or unverifiable.

subsystems.name: Explanation generation
subsystems.role: shows a human why a claim was accepted or rejected, quoting the evidence.

subsystems.name: Human-in-the-loop review
subsystems.role: routes low-confidence cases to a person and feeds corrections back into training.

buildSteps.title: Collect training data
buildSteps.detail: Assemble datasets of claims paired with evidence and true/false labels, such as the FEVER dataset, plus domain-specific examples.

buildSteps.title: Train claim extraction
buildSteps.detail: Fine-tune a language model to split text into checkable claims without losing context.

buildSteps.title: Build a retrieval index
buildSteps.detail: Crawl and index trusted sources (encyclopaedias, academic papers, government data) into a searchable vector and keyword index.

buildSteps.title: Train the verifier
buildSteps.detail: Teach a natural language inference model to read a claim and a passage and decide entailment, contradiction or neutral.

buildSteps.title: Assemble the pipeline
buildSteps.detail: Connect extraction, retrieval, source checking and verification so a single API call returns a verdict with citations.

buildSteps.title: Calibrate and evaluate
buildSteps.detail: Measure precision and recall on held-out claims, then calibrate confidence scores so uncertain answers are flagged.

buildSteps.title: Deploy with oversight
buildSteps.detail: Release as a tool that shows evidence and confidence, and sends borderline cases to human reviewers.

buildSteps.title: Maintain continuously
buildSteps.detail: Update the source index, retrain on new corrections and monitor for drift in language and facts.

prerequisites.tech: Large language models and natural language inference
prerequisites.why: they provide the core ability to compare a claim with a passage.
datasets like FEVER exist but cover limited domains and languages.
search engines and vector databases can find candidate evidence quickly.
there is no universal, machine-readable standard for judging a source's reliability.

pathway.milestone: automated flagging of unsupported citations in Wikipedia and research papers
pathway.unlocks: faster cleanup of obvious citation errors at scale.

pathway.milestone: domain-specific verifiers for medicine, law and finance
pathway.unlocks: reliable checking where sources are structured and authority is clear.

pathway.milestone: real-time verification woven into language model outputs
pathway.unlocks: answers that cite and justify each factual sentence as they are written.

pathway.milestone: auditable provenance graphs linking claims to primary evidence
pathway.unlocks: a traceable knowledge layer for journalism, science and public policy.
